## History

Early in her life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher before marrying Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). She later left her husband after a quarrel over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), returning to her own house and insisting she would only return if he got rid of the bird. The couple eventually reconciled, and Emily arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to rejoin Mr.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P1](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P2](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0002), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P4](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0004), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P5](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0005), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P6](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0006), +70 more_

## Quotes

> "I want to get acquainted with all my new neighbors just as soon as possible. Mrs. Lynde is a lovely woman, isn’t she? So friendly."
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061)

> "Well, I did think this place seemed too tidy . . . much too tidy for James A. to be living here, unless he has greatly changed since I knew him"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P14](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0014)

> "because he happens to be married already. I am his wife. Oh, you may well look surprised. I suppose he has been masquerading as a bachelor and breaking hearts right and left. Well, well, James A.,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

> "your fun is over. I am here . . . though I wouldn’t have bothered coming if I hadn’t thought you were up to some mischief. I suppose,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

Emily is married to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), though the couple was previously separated due to a feud involving his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Emily later arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) searching for him, causing a stir in the neighborhood. They ultimately reconciled, with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) thoroughly cleaning his house in preparation for her return.

- Spouse of — married couple who reconciled (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P2](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0002)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a neighbor who took an immediate interest in Emily's sudden arrival looking for her separated husband. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) actively investigated the gossip surrounding the couple's past split before Emily and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) reconciled.

- Friend of — neighbors and shopping companions (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0005)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--phil-gordon.md)

Emily is the second cousin of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's father. She runs a boarding house at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) spent a summer surrounded by Emily's eccentric fellow boarders and first met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md).

- Relative of — father's second cousin (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>
